digest.component_or_area: quality audit remediation; CI/testing, documentation, module structure, complexity metrics
propositions: Python 3.11 xdist worker reliability flake in test_opcert_service_app is root-caused as a load-dependent pytest teardown race and does not represent an app-code bug.
User-facing assignee documentation example teaches Jira-resolvable identities consistent with docs/config.md without bare unresolvable handles.

Near-capacity modules (structured_run.py, compact.py, event_append.py) are decomposed by responsibility/layer along call-graph seams with public import paths preserved to achieve sustainable code organization under the 800-line cap.

Duplicated graph loader and traversal infrastructure is centralized via load_indexed_states and shared bfs skeleton, reducing CCN of four flagged functions below the complexity threshold while preserving graph output semantics.
The attest package passes mypy --disallow-untyped-defs without errors, making it ratchet-ready for strict typing enforcement.
All changes are scoped to non-contended files with zero overlap against 212 in-progress tickets to minimize merge risk and preserve orthogonality.
